long_biography.plain_text:
Rapid7 co-founder Alan Matthews has emphasised staff development in his approach to running businesses. He advocates repeated sales training, close communication between departments and managers who help employees take on greater responsibilities. In his own sales operations, high desks encouraged staff to stand and talk, making the office a deliberately energetic place.

His competitive philosophy also favours releasing free versions of software to challenge established products and keep development moving. He has extended his involvement with entrepreneurs through Netcapital's advisory board. The investment platform allows businesses to raise money from individual investors, including their customers and wider communities.
